mask_recipe: Convex hull of each box's top_front_order plus declared bottom_pixels, scaled from 1280x720 to original 1920x1080. Marker capsule around declared two-endpoint axis, radius12px at1280 (18px at1920), extending12px beyond each endpoint; conservative cap protrusion. All source RGB bytes retained under alpha, no generative image repair/rembg/GT.
inference_notes: Official default steps50 and octree384 are intentionally bounded to30/256 before the run. The official pipeline accepts these arguments and RGBA through ImageProcessorV2. Local metric scale/pose not inferred here. One invocation per object, no reruns/best-of selection.

environment.policy: Separate venv on data volume with read-only base-site import path for existing Torch. New wheels install only in new venv; Pi3X files untouched. CPU setup must not initialize CUDA.

dependency_resolution_policy: Resolve binary wheels once with existing Torch2.5.1/NumPy1.26.4 constraints and pip retries0. Charge a conservative full-wheel allowance for resolver transfers plus1GiB metadata allowance, then count actual streamed code/config/wheel/weight body bytes. Reject a download plan above25GiB. Install downloaded wheels offline with --no-deps into the new venv only.
scope: A genuine shape-only baseline attempt under new bounded resources, not a SimFoundry rerun, texture comparison, scene-layout reconstruction, metric geometry proof or SOTA. All four rows remain even if setup is blocked. Original automatic task remains stopped.
